ctaHeading: Need a Carpenter in Melbourne? Let's Build Something Great.
aboutText: With over 20 years of hands-on carpentry experience, Craig at Rokk Carpentry delivers high-quality workmanship across Melbourne. Specialising in kitchen installations, custom cabinetry, floating shelves, and hardwood cladding, we ensure every project is completed with meticulous attention to detail. Fully insured and police-checked, our services are tailored to meet your unique needs.
servicesText: Rokk Carpentry provides a full suite of carpentry services in Melbourne, including kitchen installations, custom cabinetry, floating shelves, hardwood cladding, laundry setups, and decking. With 20+ years of experience, we ensure precision and quality in every job.

services.title: Kitchen Installation
services.desc: Expert installation of IKEA and custom kitchens, ensuring perfect fit and finish for your Melbourne home.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry

services.desc: Transform your space with stunning hardwood cladding and feature walls, crafted with precision.

services.title: Decking & Bench Seating
services.desc: Beautiful outdoor decking and bench seating installations, ideal for Melbourne's climate and lifestyle.
